summaryZh: Lukowski Lab 研究天然产物生物合成的酶过程及其生物催化潜力。实验室结合酶学、化学分析和生物信息学，识别表征新酶的底物范围及反应性，支持药物发现。
researchQuestions: 天然产物生物合成涉及哪些酶促过程？

evidence.quote: We aim to understand the enzymatic processes underlying natural product biosynthesis and explore their biocatalytic potential
We use techniques in enzymology, chemical analysis, and bioinformatics to identify and characterize new enzymes for their substrate scopes and reactivities
The Lukowski Lab at UC San Diego is located in Sverdrup Hall on the Scripps Institution of Oceanography campus.

We aim to understand the enzymatic processes underlying natural product biosynthesis and explore their biocatalytic potential in an inclusive, collaborative, and multidisciplinary research environment.
